chars.M: MECHANIC: a slim young man wearing a navy blue mechanic jumpsuit with orange reflective stripes and grease stains, a red rag hanging from the back pocket.
chars.G: GIRL: a young woman wearing a mustard yellow hijab, a long beige trench coat and white sneakers.
chars.B: BROTHER: a big broad-shouldered man with a thick black beard and bushy eyebrows, wearing a dark green tracksuit with white side stripes under a black leather jacket.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In front of a small Moroccan car repair garage on a sunny town street, the MECHANIC leans on an old red hatchback car grinning shyly at the GIRL who laughs beside it, while in the background the BROTHER stands with crossed arms glaring at the mechanic with suspicious angry eyes. Comic awkward tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a cluttered Moroccan mechanic garage with tools on the wall, the MECHANIC wipes his hands with his rag and smiles nervously while the GIRL chats with him happily, the red hatchback car with its hood open next to them.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: On a Moroccan cafe terrace with small round tables and mint tea glasses, the MECHANIC and the GIRL sit and laugh together, the mechanic gesturing with his hands telling a funny story, shy flirting mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a Moroccan street, the MECHANIC and the GIRL walk side by side chatting and smiling under warm street lights, old medina walls behind them.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At a Moroccan used car lot full of old cars, the MECHANIC stands proudly with hands on his hips imagining himself as a car dealer, a big confident smile, a stack of banknotes peeking from his jumpsuit pocket.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Next to the old red hatchback car on a Moroccan street, the GIRL hands the car keys to the MECHANIC, who receives them with both hands looking surprised and excited.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The MECHANIC sits alone in his garage at night holding the car keys, rubbing his chin with a greedy sly grin and narrowed eyes, dreaming of easy profit, the red hatchback car behind him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The MECHANIC walks nervously holding a folder of car papers toward the blue front door of a traditional Moroccan house in a narrow alley, swallowing hard, sweat drops on his head.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the doorway of a traditional Moroccan house, the huge BROTHER leans down face to face with the small terrified MECHANIC, pointing a finger at his chest with a furious suspicious frown, the mechanic sweating and leaning back clutching the car papers. Comic intimidating confrontation.
